title: Has anyone been in this family living room?
content: In my MW, there are big, gloomy apartment buildings with stairwells that go down to the restaurants, markets and clubs. It’s always night time when I’m in there. I was running through this apartment building recently and went into a scary family room that had this. The sofa area merged into a bowling alley, and there was a clown in the corner hunting me. It was horrible 🤣 anyone been here?
